BALOCHISTAN LOCAL COUNCILS DISTRICT/ZILA TAX
RULES, 1994
[Gazette
of Balochistau, Extraordinary, 3rd May, 1994]
No. 1‑181/93(BLGB)AO‑IV/4107‑4206,
dated 3‑5‑1994.‑‑ In exercise of the powers conferred
by section 150 read with section 75 of the Balochistan Local Government
Ordinance, 1980 (II of 1980) the Government of Balochistan is pleased to make
and promulgate the following rules namely‑----
CHAPTER I PRELIMINARY
1. Short title, extent
and commencement.‑‑(I) These rules may be called the Balochistan
Local Councils District/Zila Tax Rules, 1994.
(2) They shall extend
to such District Councils and with effect from such date or dates as may be
notified in this behalf by the Government from time to time.
2. Definition.‑‑In
these rules unless the context otherwise requires, the following expressions
shall have the meanings hereby respectively assigned to them that is to say:‑‑
(a) "appendix"
means the appendix to these rules;
(b) "Carbon
process" means writing a document in double faced carbon papers;
(c)
"Chairman" means the Chairman or Administrator of the District
Council;
(d)
"Clerk" means the district tax clerk;
(e)
"Council" means the District Council;
(f)
"District Council limits" means limits of the revenue district.
(g)
"exporter" means a person incharge of goods at the time of export and
includes the person on whose behalf; such goods are exported;
(h)
"export" means export from the district council limits;
(i) "District Tax
Schedule" means the District Tax Schedule notified in the Government
Gazette for the District Council;
0)
"form" means a form in the appendix;
(k)
"Government" means the Government of Balochistan;
(1) "Inspecting
Officer" means the Chairman, Chief Officer, Tax Inspector, or any other
person authorized by the Government to inspect and supervise the working of the
tax post;
(m) "lessee"
means the person in whose favour the rights of recovery of district tax have
been leased;
(n)
"Ordinance" means the Balochistan Local Government Ordinance",
1980 (II of 1980)
(o) "tax"
means the District/Zila Tax.
(p) "tax
post" means the tax post established under these rules;
(q) "vehicle"
includes a motor vehicle (private or public), Donkey Cart, Bullock cart, Camel
cart, or any other means of transportation.
CHAPTER II
TAX LIMITS, TAX BARRIERS, TAX POSTS AND TAX OFFICERS.
3. The limits for the
purposes of collection and administration of District/Zila tax, shall be the
District Council limits from which goods liable to tax are exported.
4: ‑(1) The Council
shall provide a tax office, which may be located at the council office or at
such other place in the District as the Council may deem fit.
(2) The Council may
provide such branch tax offices as may be necessary and assign to them such
functions of the tax office as may be specified from time to time.
5.‑‑(1) The
Council may fix a tax barrier on any road for interception export traffic
liable to tax and establish a tax post with such arrangements for the working
of the tax barrier as may be necessary.
(2) The Council shall assign
a name to every tax post.
(3) All tax posts,
except those in relation to which the Council by order specifies the opening
and closing times, shall remain open for twenty-?four hours.
6. A map of the District
showing the location of the tax posts, shall be kept at the tax office and
shall be available for public inspection during office hours.
7. The Council shall
provide at each tax post a suitable set of scale and weights or weighting
machine, which shall be kept in working order shall be tested from time to time
by the inspecting officers.
8.‑‑(1) The
Chief Officer of District Council shall be the Ex Officio Taxation Officer of
the Council.
(2) Subject to general
direction and control of the Chairman, the taxation officer shall be the Head
of the Taxation Department of the Council and shall among other matters be
